taskPacket.objective: A failed git command in worktree.mjs carries git's own reason into the error instead of only 'Command failed'.
instructions: Every git call in scripts/worktree.mjs runs through one helper, runGit, which on failure appends git's stderr (or its stdout when stderr is empty) to the first line of the error message and rethrows.
git() and every direct execFileSync git call in the module (update-ref, worktree add and remove, add, rm --cached, commit, diff --quiet) use that helper.
An integration test pins that a failing git() call keeps 'Command failed' and adds git's reason.
nonGoals: Changing the identity or message sealAttempt commits with.
